FIELD NOTES

Small hero. Big axe.

Explore the garden as our flower-hooded adventurer. Collect all 8 sunstones, smash 12 targets, then return to the glowing shrine. Follow the north path beyond the shrine to enter the treasure cave. Inside, walk back through the blue-lit south passage to leave. Take the flower-covered gate on the west path to Rainbow Riverside. Walk up to 18 colourful gems and stones hidden in six clusters near the riverside landmarks to collect them, cross the wooden bridge, and return through the southwest gate. Explore a flat riverside island where the water flows over the edges as waterfalls.

WASD / arrows — move
Shift — run · Space — throw
Click / Space — throw straight ahead
Drag the screen / Q / E — rotate camera
R — raise view · F — lower view
Sound — background music and effects
B near the lakeside bench — sit and hug / stand up
Scroll — zoom · Esc — close help
T near a boat dock — board together / return from Lotus Lagoon

Move to face a direction. She keeps that heading when you stop, and axes fly straight ahead. On touch screens, use the joystick and Throw.
